basic_info.description:
Experience the best of San Francisco living in this stunning Cole Valley house-like condo, combining classic charm with modern comfort. The light-filled living room features barrel-front windows and built-in seating with picturesque Golden Gate Park views. The upper level boasts an open-concept living and dining area with radiant heating, a half bath, and a gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances.
The lower level offers a private retreat with a luxurious primary suite, walk-in closet, laundry, and a spa-like bath with a soaking tub and large shower. Step outside to a beautifully landscaped backyard with a hot tub creating a serene indoor-outdoor oasis. Private backyard entrance adds an extra layer of convenience and exclusivity. Take in breathtaking views of Sutro Tower, Kezar Stadium, and Golden Gate Park from the rooftop deck.
Additional amenities include secure garage parking, keyless entry, and storage. With a 96 Walk Score, you're steps from Whole Foods, Zazie, Cha Cha Cha, and the vibrant Cole Valley and Haight-Ashbury scenes, plus easy transit access to downtown and UCSF.
